counting_rule.rule: A stack contributes `live` COUNTED instances when its layer is visible and every enclosing group is visible, else 0: live = (stack master switch on ? number of enabled instances : 0). Counted instances are limited per layer by MAX_EFFECTS_PER_LAYER (64, pigment effect_math.rs:51) and per document by MAX_EFFECTS_PER_PLAN (4096, effect_math.rs:53). Every other kept instance (hidden layer or group, switched-off stack, switched-off instance) is UNCOUNTED: no plan counts it, but it stays in the record and Folio charges it one node, so it is bounded by this crate's MAX_UNCOUNTED_EFFECTS_PER_DOCUMENT = 4096 (effects.rs:64).

history_a5eff01.approach_chosen: Both options combined, with pigment's limits as the single owner. (1) Per layer degrade with a typed loss (the lead's option b) for a stack over pigment's 64: that is the only place a document can lose something, and it is the limit the render plan would refuse anyway (PlanError::EffectLimit), so a bigger stack could not be rendered. (2) The record-validation node budget is sized from the input (option a) inside a documented hard cap, because at pigment's own limit (4096 instances) Folio needs 4096 + one node per record layer and the caller's default is 4096: a document exactly at pigment's limit would otherwise be refused. (3) Whole-import failure only past the per-plan limit, as a typed input error (PsdError::EffectLimit), never as Proposal(..), which stays the mapping-defect family. The caller budget is not raised for anything else: inspect_bytes (document nodes) still uses cfg.budget unchanged
history_a5eff01.why_not_only_sizing: Sizing alone (no per-layer cap) would admit up to 1024 instances per layer and 8192 layers, i.e. far more than pigment accepts; the render plan would then refuse the document later. The lead's rule was to admit no more than pigment accepts
history_a5eff01.why_not_only_degrade: Degrading to fit the caller's nodes would make a document that is exactly at pigment's limit lose stacks for a 64-node accounting reason (records + instances = 4160 > 4096), and would tie what imports to the caller's unrelated node setting
history_a5eff01.caller_budget_semantics: records_budget = Budget { nodes: max(cfg.budget.nodes, records + effect instances), ..cfg.budget }. The caller's input_bytes, payload_bytes, edges and depth apply unchanged.
